title: Content Writer
why_it_fits: Content Creator match. 1 skills: excel. PH-eligible (APAC mention)
position_overview: The Content Writer will be responsible for developing Filipino learning materials for the elementary level, in collaboration with other writers, editors, and subject-matter specialists. The engagement will be project-based and intermittent over a nine (9)-month period from July 2026 to March 2027, subject to adjustments based on project requirements and timelines.
key_responsibilities:
1. Planning and Content Development

Participate in planning discussions related to the development of learning materials and supporting resources.

Contribute to the establishment of editorial and language standards to ensure consistency across project outputs.

2. Manuscript Development and Content Management

Develop assigned learning content based on provided instructional frameworks, pedagogical guidelines, and curriculum competencies.

Revise and refine content based on editorial reviews and feedback to ensure quality, clarity, and alignment with educational objectives.

3. Editorial Coordination and Quality Assurance

Work closely with editors, consultants, proofreaders, designers, and other collaborators to maintain the accuracy, consistency, and effectiveness of learning materials.

Ensure that content is age-appropriate, culturally relevant, and pedagogically sound

4. Design and Production Coordination

Coordinate with designers and illustrators to ensure that written and visual elements work cohesively and support learner engagement.

5. Curriculum Alignment

Collaborate with other content developers to maintain consistency and alignment across related learning resources and teacher-support materials.

6. Production Support

Assist, as needed, in the preparation and finalization of materials for print and/or digital release.
qualifications:
At least three (3) years of experience teaching Filipino or Araling Panlipunan at the elementary level (Grades 1-6), or equivalent experience developing educational materials written in Filipino

Excellent command of the Filipino language, including grammar, syntax, tone, and usage

Strong understanding of curriculum standards, pedagogy, and learner development

Ability to evaluate materials for age appropriateness, clarity, and learner engagement

Strong collaboration and revision management skills

About Adarna House, Inc.

Adarna House is a conversation that began in 1980, when it was founded to respond to the need of Filipino children to develop their minds through enjoyable learning opportunities and memorable literary experiences. Today, this conversation includes a multitude of treasured partners who share our enthusiasm for children, our commitment to education, and our passion for reading. 

The best Filipino writers, illustrators, and researchers help us create products that feature Filipino values, culture, history, and experiences. Readability and systems experts are invaluable to the development of our materials and programs that aim to improve reading skills in Filipino. A new generation of readers, beyond the Philippines, have also pushed us towards engaging with them on a different platform through Buribooks.

Our literacy programs are born of our relationships with the public and private sectors. We continue to strengthen these alliances with the help of our primary allies-The Raya School, which offers progressive education from preschool to high school, and the Adarna Group Foundation, Inc. (AGFI), which focuses on local government-based early literacy programs.
